name: Pedro Tabuada • Dj Vibe Tribute
description: DJ Pedro Tabuada performs an all-night set dedicated to DJ Vibe, his lifelong idol. This event is a tribute to the artist who shaped Tabuada's approach to music and the dancefloor.
longDescription:
Pedro Tabuada, with over 25 years of experience as a DJ, presents a special tribute night dedicated to DJ Vibe. Tabuada has previously honored artists like Kerri Chandler, Masters at Work, and Frankie Knuckles through his tribute sets.

The event takes place on November 4th at Era Uma Vez no Porto..., located at Rua da Madeira 126, 4000-330 Porto. The music starts at 11:59 PM and continues until 5:50 AM.

Tickets are available in several releases, starting from €5.00 for the R4W Community Tickets, €7.00 for the 1st Release, and €10.00 for the 2nd Release. Attendees can resell their tickets through the Shotgun app if their plans change.
descriptionPt: DJ Pedro Tabuada atua a noite toda num set dedicado a DJ Vibe, o seu ídolo de sempre. Este evento é uma homenagem ao artista que moldou a abordagem de Tabuada à música e à pista de dança.
